# {project_name} - Design Spec

## I. Project Information

| Item | Value |
| ---- | ----- |
| **Project Name** | {project_name} |
| **Canvas Format** | {canvas_info['name']} ({canvas_info['dimensions']}) |
| **Page Count** | [Filled by Strategist] |
| **Design Style** | {design_style} |
| **Target Audience** | [Filled by Strategist] |
| **Use Case** | [Filled by Strategist] |
| **Created Date** | {date_str} |

---

## II. Canvas Specification

| Property | Value |
| -------- | ----- |
| **Format** | {canvas_info['name']} |
| **Dimensions** | {canvas_info['dimensions']} |
| **viewBox** | `{canvas_info['viewbox']}` |
| **Margins** | [Recommended by Strategist, e.g., left/right 60px, top/bottom 50px] |
| **Content Area** | [Calculated from canvas] |

---

## III. Visual Theme

### Theme Style

- **Style**: {design_style}
- **Theme**: [Light theme / Dark theme]
- **Tone**: [Filled by Strategist, e.g., tech, professional, modern, innovative]

### Color Scheme

> Strategist should determine specific color values based on project content, industry, and brand colors

| Role | HEX | Purpose |
| ---- | --- | ------- |
| **Background** | `#......` | Page background (light theme typically white; dark theme dark gray/navy) |
| **Secondary bg** | `#......` | Card background, section background |
| **Primary** | `#......` | Title decorations, key sections, icons |
| **Accent** | `#......` | Data highlights, key information, links |
| **Secondary accent** | `#......` | Secondary emphasis, gradient transitions |
| **Body text** | `#......` | Main body text (dark theme uses light text) |
| **Secondary text** | `#......` | Captions, annotations |
| **Tertiary text** | `#......` | Supplementary info, footers |
| **Border/divider** | `#......` | Card borders, divider lines |
| **Success** | `#......` | Positive indicators (green family) |
| **Warning** | `#......` | Issue markers (red family) |

> **Reference**: Industry colors in `references/strategist.md` or `scripts/config.py` under `INDUSTRY_COLORS`

### Gradient Scheme (if needed, using SVG syntax)

```xml
<!-- Title gradient -->
<linearGradient id="titleGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
  <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#[primary]"/>
  <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#[secondary accent]"/>
</linearGradient>

<!-- Background decorative gradient (note: rgba forbidden, use stop-opacity) -->
<radialGradient id="bgDecor" cx="80%" cy="20%" r="50%">
  <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#[primary]" stop-opacity="0.15"/>
  <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#[primary]" stop-opacity="0"/>
</radialGradient>
```

---

## IV. Typography System

### Font Plan

> Strategist should select a font preset based on content characteristics, or customize the font combination
> Preset descriptions: P1=Modern business/tech | P2=Government docs | P3=Culture/arts | P4=Traditional/conservative | P5=English-primary

**Recommended preset**: [Fill in preset code]

| Role | Chinese | English | Fallback |
| ---- | ------- | ------- | -------- |
| **Title** | [font name] | [font name] | [font name] |
| **Body** | [font name] | [font name] | [font name] |
| **Code** | - | Consolas | Monaco |
| **Emphasis** | [font name] | [font name] | [font name] |

**Font stack**: `[Fill in CSS font-family string]`

### Font Size Hierarchy

> **Design principle**: Use body font size as baseline (1x), derive other levels proportionally
> **Unit convention**: Use px uniformly (SVG native unit) to avoid pt/px conversion errors
> **Selection principle**: Font size is based on **content density**, not design style

**Baseline**: Body font size = [fill in]px (choose 18-24px based on content density)

| Purpose | Ratio | 24px baseline (relaxed) | 18px baseline (dense) | Weight |
| ------- | ----- | ---------------------- | -------------------- | ------ |
| Cover title | 2.5-3x | 60-72px | 45-54px | Bold |
| Chapter title | 2-2.5x | 48-60px | 36-45px | Bold |
| Content title | 1.5-2x | 36-48px | 27-36px | Bold |
| Subtitle | 1.2-1.5x | 29-36px | 22-27px | SemiBold |
| **Body content** | **1x** | **24px** | **18px** | Regular |
| Annotation | 0.75-0.85x | 18-20px | 14-15px | Regular |
| Page number/date | 0.55-0.65x | 13-16px | 10-12px | Regular |

> **Tip**: Dense content (6+ points per page) use 18px; relaxed content (3-5 points per page) use 24px

---

## V. Layout Principles

### Page Structure

- **Header area**: [Height and content description]
- **Content area**: [Height and content description]
- **Footer area**: [Height and content description]

### Common Layout Modes

| Mode | Suitable Scenarios |
| ---- | ----------------- |
| **Single column centered** | Covers, conclusions, key points |
| **Left-right split (5:5)** | Comparisons, dual concepts |
| **Left-right split (4:6)** | Image-text mix |
| **Top-bottom split** | Processes, timelines |
| **Three/four column cards** | Feature lists, team introductions |
| **Matrix grid** | Comparative analysis, classifications |

### Spacing Specification

> Strategist may adjust based on project needs

| Element | Recommended Range | Current Project |
| ------- | ---------------- | --------------- |
| Card gap | 20-32px | [fill in] |
| Content block gap | 24-40px | [fill in] |
| Card padding | 20-32px | [fill in] |
| Card border radius | 8-16px | [fill in] |
| Icon-text gap | 8-16px | [fill in] |
| Single-row card height | 530-600px | [fill in] |
| Double-row card height | 265-295px each | [fill in] |
| Three-column card width | 360-380px each | [fill in] |

---

## VI. Icon Usage Specification

### Source

- **Built-in icon library**: `templates/icons/` (640+ icons)
- **Usage method**: Placeholder format `{{icon:category/icon-name}}`

### Recommended Icon List (fill as needed)

| Purpose | Icon Path | Page |
| ------- | --------- | ---- |
| [example] | `{{icon:interface/check-circle}}` | Slide XX |

---

## VII. Chart Reference List (if needed)

> When the presentation includes data visualization, Strategist selects chart types from `templates/charts/charts_index.json` and lists them here for the Executor to reference.

| Chart Type | Reference Template | Used In |
| ---------- | ------------------ | ------- |
| [e.g. grouped_bar_chart] | `templates/charts/grouped_bar_chart.svg` | Slide 05 |

---

## VIII. Image Resource List (if needed)

| Filename | Dimensions | Ratio | Purpose | Type | Status | Generation Description |
| -------- | --------- | ----- | ------- | ---- | ------ | --------------------- |
| cover_bg.png | {canvas_info['dimensions']} | [ratio] | Cover background | [Background/Photography/Illustration/Diagram/Decorative] | [Pending/Existing/Placeholder] | [AI generation prompt] |

**Status descriptions**:

- **Pending** - Needs AI generation, provide detailed description
- **Existing** - User already has image, place in `images/`
- **Placeholder** - Not yet processed, use dashed border placeholder in SVG

**Type descriptions** (used by Image_Generator for prompt strategy selection):

- **Background** - Full-page background for covers/chapters, reserve text area
- **Photography** - Real scenes, people, products, architecture
- **Illustration** - Flat design, vector style, cartoon, concept diagrams
- **Diagram** - Flowcharts, architecture diagrams, concept maps
- **Decorative** - Partial decorations, textures, borders, dividers

---

## IX. Content Outline

### Part 1: [Chapter Name]

#### Slide 01 - Cover

- **Layout**: Full-screen background image + centered title
- **Title**: [Main title]
- **Subtitle**: [Subtitle]
- **Info**: [Author / Date / Organization]

#### Slide 02 - [Page Name]

- **Layout**: [Choose layout mode]
- **Title**: [Page title]
- **Chart**: [chart_type] (see VII. Chart Reference List)
- **Content**:
  - [Point 1]
  - [Point 2]
  - [Point 3]

> **Chart field**: Only add when the page includes data visualization. Chart type must be listed in section VII.

---

[Strategist continues adding more pages based on source document content and page count planning...]

---

## X. Speaker Notes Requirements

Generate corresponding speaker note files for each page, saved to the `notes/` directory:

- **File naming**: Match SVG names, e.g., `01_cover.md`
- **Content includes**: Script key points, timing cues, transition phrases

---

## XI. Technical Constraints Reminder

### SVG Generation Must Follow:

1. viewBox: `{canvas_info['viewbox']}`
2. Background uses `<rect>` elements
3. Text wrapping uses `<tspan>` (`<foreignObject>` FORBIDDEN)
4. Transparency uses `fill-opacity` / `stroke-opacity`; `rgba()` FORBIDDEN
5. FORBIDDEN: `clipPath`, `mask`, `<style>`, `class`, `foreignObject`
6. FORBIDDEN: `textPath`, `animate*`, `script`, `marker`/`marker-end`
7. Arrows use `<polygon>` triangles instead of `<marker>`

### PPT Compatibility Rules:

- `<g opacity="...">` FORBIDDEN (group opacity); set on each child element individually
- Image transparency uses overlay mask layer (`<rect fill="bg-color" opacity="0.x"/>`)
- Inline styles only; external CSS and `@font-face` FORBIDDEN

---

## XII. Design Checklist

### Pre-generation

- [ ] Content fits page capacity
- [ ] Layout mode selected correctly
- [ ] Colors used semantically

### Post-generation

- [ ] viewBox = `{canvas_info['viewbox']}`
- [ ] No `<foreignObject>` elements
- [ ] All text readable (>=14px)
- [ ] Content within safe area
- [ ] All elements aligned to grid
- [ ] Same elements maintain consistent style
- [ ] Colors conform to spec
- [ ] CRAP four-principle check passed

---

## XIII. Next Steps

1. ✅ Design spec complete
2. **Next step**: [Choose based on image approach]
   - No AI images → Invoke **Executor** role to generate SVGs
   - Has AI images → Invoke **Image_Generator** role, then invoke Executor after completion

results.content:
1	# Anthropic Style Template - Design Specification
2	
3	> Suitable for AI/LLM tech talks, developer conferences, technical training, product launches, and similar scenarios.
4	
5	---
6	
7	## I. Template Overview
8	
9	| Property       | Description                                            |
10	| -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
11	| **Template Name** | anthropic (Anthropic Style Template)                |
12	| **Use Cases**  | AI tech talks, developer conferences, technical training, product launches |
13	| **Design Tone** | Tech-forward, professional, modern, conclusion-first |
14	| **Theme Mode** | Mixed theme (dark cover/chapter + light content pages) |
15	
16	---
17	
18	## II. Canvas Specification
19	
20	| Property       | Value                         |
21	| -------------- | ----------------------------- |
22	| **Format**     | Standard 16:9                 |
23	| **Dimensions** | 1280 × 720 px                |
24	| **viewBox**    | `0 0 1280 720`                |
25	| **Safe Margins** | 60px (left/right), 50px (top/bottom) |
26	| **Content Area** | x: 60-1220, y: 100-670     |
27	| **Title Area** | y: 50-100                     |
28	| **Grid Base**  | 40px                          |
29	
30	---
31	
32	## III. Color Scheme
33	
34	### Primary Colors
35	
36	| Role             | Value       | Notes                            |
37	| ---------------- | ----------- | -------------------------------- |
38	| **Anthropic Orange** | `#D97757` | Brand identity, title emphasis, key data |
39	| **Deep Space Gray** | `#1A1A2E` | Cover background, body text, chart base |
40	| **Tech Blue**    | `#4A90D9`   | Flowcharts, links, interactive elements |
41	| **Mint Green**   | `#10B981`   | Recommended options, positive indicators, success states |
42	| **Coral Red**    | `#EF4444`   | Risks, cautions, warnings        |
43	
44	### Neutral Colors
45	
46	| Role           | Value       | Usage                  |
47	| -------------- | ----------- | ---------------------- |
48	| **Cloud White** | `#F8FAFC`  | Card background        |
49	| **Border Gray** | `#E2E8F0`  | Card borders, dividers |
50	| **Slate Gray** | `#64748B`   | Secondary text, chart labels |
51	| **Pure White** | `#FFFFFF`   | Page background        |
52	
53	---
54	
55	## IV. Typography System
56	
57	### Font Stack
58	
59	**Font Stack**: `Arial, "Helvetica Neue", "Segoe UI", sans-serif`
60	
61	### Font Size Hierarchy
62	
63	| Level    | Usage            | Size   | Weight  |
64	| -------- | ---------------- | ------ | ------- |
65	| H1       | Cover main title | 56px   | Bold    |
66	| H2       | Page title       | 32-36px| Bold    |
67	| H3       | Subtitle/section | 24-28px| Semibold|
68	| H4       | Card title       | 20-22px| Bold    |
69	| P        | Body content     | 16-18px| Regular |
70	| Data     | Highlighted data | 40-48px| Bold    |
71	| Label    | Label text       | 14px   | 500     |
72	| Sub      | Chart labels/footnotes | 12-14px | Regular |
73	
74	---
75	
76	## V. Core Design Principles
77	
78	### Top-Tier Consulting Style
79	
80	1. **Conclusion First (Pyramid Principle)**: Each page title is the core takeaway
81	2. **Data Contextualization**: Comparisons, trends, benchmarks — never present data in isolation
82	3. **SCQA Framework**: Situation → Complication → Question → Answer
83	4. **MECE Principle**: Mutually Exclusive, Collectively Exhaustive
84	5. **Professional Whitespace**: Content ratio < 65%, let information "breathe"
85	
86	---
87	
88	## VI. Page Structure
89	
90	### General Layout
91	
92	| Area           | Position/Height | Description                            |
93	| -------------- | --------------- | -------------------------------------- |
94	| **Top**        | y=0, h=6-8px    | Anthropic Orange decorative bar        |
95	| **Label**      | y=50-70         | Page type label (uppercase, orange)    |
96	| **Title Area** | y=80-140        | Page title (core takeaway)             |
97	| **Content Area** | y=160-620     | Main content area                      |
98	| **Footer**     | y=680           | Page number (centered)                 |
99	
100	### Decorative Elements
101	
102	- **Top Orange Bar**: Anthropic Orange (`#D97757`), height 6px
103	- **Left Gradient Bar**: Orange gradient (`#D97757` → `#E8956F`)
104	- **Card Border**: Light gray (`#E2E8F0`)
105	- **Card Shadow**: Soft shadow effect
106	- **Grid Decoration Lines**: White low-opacity grid on dark covers
107	
108	---
109	
110	## VII. Page Types
111	
112	### 1. Cover Page (01_cover.svg)
113	
114	- Dark gradient background (`#1A1A2E` → `#16213E` → `#0F0F1A`)
115	- Grid decoration lines (white, 3% opacity)
116	- Orange and blue glow effects
117	- Neural network-style connection lines and nodes
118	- Centered main title (white) + subtitle
119	- Orange decorative short line
120	- Bottom date and source info
121	
122	### 2. Table of Contents Page (02_toc.svg)
123	
124	- White background
125	- Left orange gradient decorative bar (8px)
126	- Orange circular numbers + chapter titles
127	- Right-side complexity progression illustration
128	
129	### 3. Chapter Page (02_chapter.svg)
130	
131	- Dark gradient background
132	- Grid decoration
133	- Centered large chapter title
134	- Orange decorative line
135	
136	### 4. Content Page (03_content.svg)
137	
138	- White background
139	- Top orange decorative bar
140	- Page type label (orange uppercase)
141	- Title as core takeaway
142	- Three-column card layout (colored top borders)
143	- Footer with centered page number
144	
145	### 5. Ending Page (04_ending.svg)
146	
147	- Dark gradient background
148	- Neural network decoration
149	- Centered thank-you message
150	- Contact information
151	
152	---
153	
154	## VIII. Common Components
155	
156	### Card Style
157	
158	```xml
159	<!-- Card with shadow -->
160	<g filter="url(#cardShadow)">
161	    <path fill="#F8FAFC" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="1"
162	          d="M72,180 H408 A12,12 0 0 1 420,192 V588 A12,12 0 0 1 408,600 H72 A12,12 0 0 1 60,588 V192 A12,12 0 0 1 72,180 Z"/>
163	</g>
164	<!-- Top colored decorative bar -->
165	<rect x="60" y="180" width="360" height="6" fill="#10B981"/>
166	```
167	
168	### Circular Number
169	
170	```xml
171	<circle cx="90" cy="200" r="24" fill="#D97757"/>
172	<text x="90" y="207" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
173	```
174	
175	### Icon Background Circle
176	
177	```xml
178	<circle cx="130" cy="250" r="35" fill="#10B981" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
179	```
180	
181	---
182	
183	## IX. Spacing Guidelines
184	
185	| Element          | Value  |
186	| ---------------- | ------ |
187	| Safe margin      | 60px   |
188	| Card gap         | 30-40px|
189	| Card border radius | 8-12px |
190	| Card padding     | 30px   |
191	| Grid base        | 40px   |
192	
193	---
194	
195	## X. SVG Technical Constraints
196	
197	### Mandatory Rules
198	
199	1. viewBox: `0 0 1280 720`
200	2. Use `<rect>` elements for backgrounds
201	3. Use `<tspan>` for text wrapping (**strictly no** `<foreignObject>`)
202	4. Use `fill-opacity` / `stroke-opacity` for transparency
203	5. Prohibited: `clipPath`, `mask`, `<style>`, `class`, `foreignObject`
204	6. Prohibited: `textPath`, `animate*`, `script`
205	7. Define gradients using `<defs>`
206	
207	### PPT Compatibility Rules
208	
209	- No `<g opacity="...">` (group opacity)
210	- Inline styles only
211	
212	---
213	
214	## XI. Placeholder Specification
215	
216	| Placeholder        | Description        |
217	| ------------------ | ------------------ |
218	| `{{TITLE}}`        | Main title         |
219	| `{{SUBTITLE}}`     | Subtitle           |
220	| `{{SOURCE}}`       | Source info        |
221	| `{{DATE}}`         | Date               |
222	| `{{PAGE_TITLE}}`   | Page title (core takeaway) |
223	| `{{PAGE_LABEL}}`   | Page type label    |
224	| `{{CHAPTER_NUM}}`  | Chapter number     |
225	| `{{CHAPTER_TITLE}}`| Chapter title      |
226	| `{{PAGE_NUM}}`     | Page number        |
227	| `{{TOTAL_PAGES}}`  | Total pages        |
228	
229	---
230	
231	## XII. Usage Instructions
232	
233	1. Copy the template to the project directory
234	2. Select the appropriate page template based on content needs
235	3. **Title is the core takeaway** — ensure each page has a clear conclusion
236	4. Use three accent colors to differentiate content types (green = recommended, blue = process, orange = emphasis)
237	5. Generate the final SVG through the Executor role
238

# Anthropic Style Template - Design Specification

> Suitable for AI/LLM tech talks, developer conferences, technical training, product launches, and similar scenarios.

---

## I. Template Overview

| Property       | Description                                            |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Template Name** | anthropic (Anthropic Style Template)                |
| **Use Cases**  | AI tech talks, developer conferences, technical training, product launches |
| **Design Tone** | Tech-forward, professional, modern, conclusion-first |
| **Theme Mode** | Mixed theme (dark cover/chapter + light content pages) |

---

## II. Canvas Specification

| Property       | Value                         |
| -------------- | ----------------------------- |
| **Format**     | Standard 16:9                 |
| **Dimensions** | 1280 × 720 px                |
| **viewBox**    | `0 0 1280 720`                |
| **Safe Margins** | 60px (left/right), 50px (top/bottom) |
| **Content Area** | x: 60-1220, y: 100-670     |
| **Title Area** | y: 50-100                     |
| **Grid Base**  | 40px                          |

---

## III. Color Scheme

### Primary Colors

| Role             | Value       | Notes                            |
| ---------------- | ----------- | -------------------------------- |
| **Anthropic Orange** | `#D97757` | Brand identity, title emphasis, key data |
| **Deep Space Gray** | `#1A1A2E` | Cover background, body text, chart base |
| **Tech Blue**    | `#4A90D9`   | Flowcharts, links, interactive elements |
| **Mint Green**   | `#10B981`   | Recommended options, positive indicators, success states |
| **Coral Red**    | `#EF4444`   | Risks, cautions, warnings        |

### Neutral Colors

| Role           | Value       | Usage                  |
| -------------- | ----------- | ---------------------- |
| **Cloud White** | `#F8FAFC`  | Card background        |
| **Border Gray** | `#E2E8F0`  | Card borders, dividers |
| **Slate Gray** | `#64748B`   | Secondary text, chart labels |
| **Pure White** | `#FFFFFF`   | Page background        |

---

## IV. Typography System

### Font Stack

**Font Stack**: `Arial, "Helvetica Neue", "Segoe UI", sans-serif`

### Font Size Hierarchy

| Level    | Usage            | Size   | Weight  |
| -------- | ---------------- | ------ | ------- |
| H1       | Cover main title | 56px   | Bold    |
| H2       | Page title       | 32-36px| Bold    |
| H3       | Subtitle/section | 24-28px| Semibold|
| H4       | Card title       | 20-22px| Bold    |
| P        | Body content     | 16-18px| Regular |
| Data     | Highlighted data | 40-48px| Bold    |
| Label    | Label text       | 14px   | 500     |
| Sub      | Chart labels/footnotes | 12-14px | Regular |

---

## V. Core Design Principles

### Top-Tier Consulting Style

1. **Conclusion First (Pyramid Principle)**: Each page title is the core takeaway
2. **Data Contextualization**: Comparisons, trends, benchmarks — never present data in isolation
3. **SCQA Framework**: Situation → Complication → Question → Answer
4. **MECE Principle**: Mutually Exclusive, Collectively Exhaustive
5. **Professional Whitespace**: Content ratio < 65%, let information "breathe"

---

## VI. Page Structure

### General Layout

| Area           | Position/Height | Description                            |
| -------------- | --------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| **Top**        | y=0, h=6-8px    | Anthropic Orange decorative bar        |
| **Label**      | y=50-70         | Page type label (uppercase, orange)    |
| **Title Area** | y=80-140        | Page title (core takeaway)             |
| **Content Area** | y=160-620     | Main content area                      |
| **Footer**     | y=680           | Page number (centered)                 |

### Decorative Elements

- **Top Orange Bar**: Anthropic Orange (`#D97757`), height 6px
- **Left Gradient Bar**: Orange gradient (`#D97757` → `#E8956F`)
- **Card Border**: Light gray (`#E2E8F0`)
- **Card Shadow**: Soft shadow effect
- **Grid Decoration Lines**: White low-opacity grid on dark covers

---

## VII. Page Types

### 1. Cover Page (01_cover.svg)

- Dark gradient background (`#1A1A2E` → `#16213E` → `#0F0F1A`)
- Grid decoration lines (white, 3% opacity)
- Orange and blue glow effects
- Neural network-style connection lines and nodes
- Centered main title (white) + subtitle
- Orange decorative short line
- Bottom date and source info

### 2. Table of Contents Page (02_toc.svg)

- White background
- Left orange gradient decorative bar (8px)
- Orange circular numbers + chapter titles
- Right-side complexity progression illustration

### 3. Chapter Page (02_chapter.svg)

- Dark gradient background
- Grid decoration
- Centered large chapter title
- Orange decorative line

### 4. Content Page (03_content.svg)

- White background
- Top orange decorative bar
- Page type label (orange uppercase)
- Title as core takeaway
- Three-column card layout (colored top borders)
- Footer with centered page number

### 5. Ending Page (04_ending.svg)

- Dark gradient background
- Neural network decoration
- Centered thank-you message
- Contact information

---

## VIII. Common Components

### Card Style

```xml
<!-- Card with shadow -->
<g filter="url(#cardShadow)">
    <path fill="#F8FAFC" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="1"
          d="M72,180 H408 A12,12 0 0 1 420,192 V588 A12,12 0 0 1 408,600 H72 A12,12 0 0 1 60,588 V192 A12,12 0 0 1 72,180 Z"/>
</g>
<!-- Top colored decorative bar -->
<rect x="60" y="180" width="360" height="6" fill="#10B981"/>
```

### Circular Number

```xml
<circle cx="90" cy="200" r="24" fill="#D97757"/>
<text x="90" y="207" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
```

### Icon Background Circle

```xml
<circle cx="130" cy="250" r="35" fill="#10B981" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
```

---

## IX. Spacing Guidelines

| Element          | Value  |
| ---------------- | ------ |
| Safe margin      | 60px   |
| Card gap         | 30-40px|
| Card border radius | 8-12px |
| Card padding     | 30px   |
| Grid base        | 40px   |

---

## X. SVG Technical Constraints

### Mandatory Rules

1. viewBox: `0 0 1280 720`
2. Use `<rect>` elements for backgrounds
3. Use `<tspan>` for text wrapping (**strictly no** `<foreignObject>`)
4. Use `fill-opacity` / `stroke-opacity` for transparency
5. Prohibited: `clipPath`, `mask`, `<style>`, `class`, `foreignObject`
6. Prohibited: `textPath`, `animate*`, `script`
7. Define gradients using `<defs>`

### PPT Compatibility Rules

- No `<g opacity="...">` (group opacity)
- Inline styles only

---

## XI. Placeholder Specification

| Placeholder        | Description        |
| ------------------ | ------------------ |
| `{{TITLE}}`        | Main title         |
| `{{SUBTITLE}}`     | Subtitle           |
| `{{SOURCE}}`       | Source info        |
| `{{DATE}}`         | Date               |
| `{{PAGE_TITLE}}`   | Page title (core takeaway) |
| `{{PAGE_LABEL}}`   | Page type label    |
| `{{CHAPTER_NUM}}`  | Chapter number     |
| `{{CHAPTER_TITLE}}`| Chapter title      |
| `{{PAGE_NUM}}`     | Page number        |
| `{{TOTAL_PAGES}}`  | Total pages        |

---

## XII. Usage Instructions

1. Copy the template to the project directory
2. Select the appropriate page template based on content needs
3. **Title is the core takeaway** — ensure each page has a clear conclusion
4. Use three accent colors to differentiate content types (green = recommended, blue = process, orange = emphasis)
5. Generate the final SVG through the Executor role

- **Title**: GitHub Trending Repos Snapshot: The Rise of AI Coding Agents & Claude Code Skills
- **Subtitle**: Analyzing the Top 20 Trending Repositories in the Past 24 Hours
- **Info**: Source: OSSInsight.io | 10.6B+ GitHub Events | April 2026

  - KPI: Real-time analytics across all languages

#### Slide 03 — Top 5 Repos by Total Score

- **Layout**: Horizontal bar chart / ranked table
- **Label**: TOP REPOS
- **Title**: hermes-agent Leads with 1,347 Stars — Top 5 Repos by Total Score

  - #5 shanraisshan/claude-code-best-practice: 304 stars, 23 forks, 0 pushes, 0 PRs
  - Callout: #1 has 1.8x more stars than #2

- **Title**: Python and TypeScript Dominate Trending Repos' Language Mix

- **Layout**: Treemap / stacked bar visual
- **Label**: CATEGORIES
- **Title**: 14 of 20 Trending Repos Are AI Coding Agent or Claude Code Projects
- **Chart**: treemap_chart
- **Content**:
  - AI Coding Agents & Skills: ~10 repos (50%)
  - Claude Code Ecosystem Tools: ~5 repos (25%)
  - AI Infrastructure & Research: ~3 repos (15%)
  - Developer Utilities: ~3 repos (15%)
  - Key insight: ~70% directly related to AI coding assistance

#### Slide 06 — Claude Code Ecosystem

- **Layout**: Network/hub-spoke diagram with cards
- **Label**: ECOSYSTEM
- **Title**: Claude Code Spawns an Ecosystem: Skills, Guides, Switches, and Best Practices
- **Content**:
  - Core 5 repos: claude-code-best-practice, claude-howto, cc-switch, caveman, learn-claude-code

  - Categories: Skills (caveman, graphify), Guides (claude-howto, best-practice), Switchers (cc-switch), Learning (learn-claude-code)
  - Insight: Rapid community formation around Anthropic's coding tool

#### Slide 07 — Community Engagement

- **Layout**: Scatter plot or grouped bar chart
- **Label**: ENGAGEMENT
- **Title**: hermes-agent Draws 78 PRs and 42 Pushes — Community Activity Varies Widely
- **Chart**: scatter_chart
- **Content**:
  - High engagement: hermes-agent (78 PRs, 42 pushes), multica (7 PRs, 35 pushes)

  - Insight: Community activity heavily concentrated at top; most repos are early-stage or single-author

#### Slide 08 — Key Takeaways

- **Layout**: Single column with icon bullets
- **Label**: TAKEAWAYS
- **Title**: Key Takeaways: AI Coding Agents Are GitHub's Hottest Category
- **Content**:
  - 14/20 trending repos (70%) are AI coding agent tools — unprecedented concentration
  - Claude Code ecosystem: 7+ repos (skills, guides, best practices) formed overnight

1	# Executor Consultant — Consulting Style
2	
3	> Common guidelines: executor-base.md. Technical constraints: shared-standards.md.
4	
5	---
6	
7	## Role Definition
8	
9	A data-driven, consulting-style SVG design executor. Suitable for business analysis reports, market research, operational reviews, strategic recommendations, and other **general consulting** scenarios. Emphasizes structured information presentation and data visualization; clean, clear, and professional style.
10	
11	---
12	
13	## Consultant-specific Data Visualization Techniques
14	
15	### 1. KPI Dashboard Design
16	
17	KPI cards are the most common element in consulting reports. Standard layout (1280x720):
18	
19	```
20	4-card layout: each card 280x180, gap 30
21	  Card 1: x=45,  y=160
22	  Card 2: x=355, y=160
23	  Card 3: x=665, y=160
24	  Card 4: x=975, y=160
25	```
26	
27	**Card internal structure** (top to bottom):
28	
29	| Area | Content | Font Size | Style |
30	|------|---------|-----------|-------|
31	| Icon row | data-icon icon | 32x32 | Theme color |
32	| Metric name | "Monthly Active Users" | 14px | Gray #64748B |
33	| Core number | "1.2M" | 36-42px | Bold, dark color |
34	| Trend annotation | "+12.3% vs last month" | 12px | Green=up / Red=down |
35	
36	**Trend arrow conventions**:
37	- Up: `arrow-trend-up` icon + green text
38	- Down: `arrow-trend-down` icon + red text
39	- Flat: horizontal line icon + gray text
40	
41	### 2. Chart Color Conventions
42	
43	Consulting-style charts use **monochromatic depth gradients** rather than rainbow colors:
44	
45	```
46	Primary series:   Theme color 100% opacity
47	Comparison series: Theme color 60% opacity
48	Baseline:         #94A3B8 (gray dashed line)
49	Highlight:        Accent color (only for key data points)
50	```
51	
52	### 3. Data Annotation Principles
53	
54	- **Direct data labels**: Place values at the top of bar charts — no legend needed
55	- **Annotated trend lines**: Add text notes at key inflection points ("Policy change", "Product launch")
56	- **Comparison baselines**: Mark industry average / target values with gray dashed lines
57	- **Consistent units**: Maintain the same numeric units and precision within a chart
58	
59	### 4. Table Design
60	
61	Consulting reports frequently use tables for precise data:
62	
63	| Design Element | Specification |
64	|----------------|---------------|
65	| Header | Dark background + white text, font-weight="bold" |
66	| Zebra striping | Alternate rows with `fill-opacity="0.05"` light background |
67	| Number alignment | Numbers right-aligned, text left-aligned |
68	| Highlighted row | Mark key rows with accent color `fill-opacity="0.1"` |
69	| Borders | Use horizontal lines only to separate rows; avoid full grid lines |
70	
71	---
72	
73	## Consulting-specific Layout Patterns
74	
75	### MECE Decomposition Tree
76	
77	Main trunk on the left, branches expanding rightward — mutually exclusive, collectively exhaustive:
78	
79	```
80	Main metric ──┬── Branch A (45%)
81	              ├── Branch B (30%)
82	              ├── Branch C (20%)
83	              └── Branch D (5%)
84	```
85	
86	- Use `<line>` to connect trunk to branches
87	- Each branch has a `<rect>` container + percentage annotation
88	- Sum must = 100% (or explicitly label "Other")
89	
90	### Driver Factor Tree
91	
92	Top-level metric → decomposed factors → actions. Ideal for performance attribution analysis:
93	
94	```
95	Revenue growth 15%
96	  ├── Average order value +8%  → Premium product line expansion
97	  ├── Customer count +5%       → New channel acquisition
98	  └── Repurchase rate +2%      → Loyalty program optimization
99	```
100	
101	### Left-chart Right-text (Chart Interpretation)
102	
103	Core consulting report layout: chart on the left, key insights on the right:
104	
105	```
106	Chart area: x=40, y=120, w=700, h=480
107	Insight area: x=780, y=120, w=460, h=480
108	  - Core conclusion (bold, 16px)
109	  - 3-5 bullet points (14px)
110	  - Data source (12px, gray)
111	```
112	
113	---
114	
115	## Professional Expression Standards
116	
117	### Page Titles
118	
119	Consulting-style page titles should be **assertion headlines**, not descriptive titles:
120	
121	| Type | Descriptive (avoid) | Assertion (recommended) |
122	|------|---------------------|------------------------|
123	| Market | "Market Overview" | "Domestic market grows 23% YoY, significantly outpacing global average" |
124	| Competition | "Competitive Analysis" | "Three major competitors show clear weaknesses in channel coverage" |
125	| Finance | "Financial Data" | "Gross margin improved for four consecutive quarters, breaking industry ceiling" |
126	
127	### Data Source Attribution
128	
129	Every data-containing page must include a source note at the bottom:
130	
131	```xml
132	<text x="40" y="700" font-size="10" fill="#94A3B8">
133	  Source: National Bureau of Statistics 2025 Annual Report; Internal team analysis
134	</text>
135	```
136	
137	### Key Takeaway Box
138	
139	Consulting-style content pages should include a **Takeaway Box** below the title:
140	
141	```
142	Position: x=40, y=80, w=1200, h=50
143	Background: Light theme color (fill-opacity="0.08")
144	Text: 14-16px, one-sentence summary of the page's core takeaway
145	```
146	
147	---
148	
149	## Speaker Notes Style
150	
151	### Narrative Tone
152	
153	Consultant-style speaker notes use a **conclusion-driven** approach — state the conclusion first, then present supporting evidence. Professional, concise, and persuasive tone.
154	
155	### Stage Direction Markers
156	
157	| Marker | Purpose | Example |
158	|--------|---------|---------|
159	| `[Pause]` | Silence after key conclusions, let the audience absorb | "This means our market share is being eroded. [Pause]" |
160	| `[Data]` | Cue to verbalize numbers conversationally | "[Data] 85% → more than eight out of ten customers reported this issue" |
161	| `[Transition]` | Bridge from previous page, must be at start of each page's text | "[Transition] Based on that analysis, let's look at specific recommendations." |
162	
163	### Notes Writing Guidelines
164	
165	- **Conclusion first**: The first sentence of each page's notes is the core takeaway
166	- **Conversational data**: 30% → "roughly one-third", 85% → "more than eight out of ten", 2.5x → "two and a half times"
167	- **Evidence follows immediately**: After the conclusion, provide 2-3 supporting data points/facts
168	- **Professional terminology**: Use terms like "insight", "driver", "key lever" etc.
169	- **Key points structure**: `Key points: (1) Core conclusion (2) Supporting data (3) Next steps`
170	
171	### Notes Example
172	
173	```markdown
174	# 03_key_findings
175	
176	[Transition] Based on our market scan, we have distilled three key findings.
177	
178	First, the primary growth driver is shifting from acquisition to retention.
179	[Data] New customer acquisition cost rose nearly 40% year-over-year, yet improved repurchase rates contributed over 60% of revenue growth. [Pause]
180	
181	Second, lower-tier market growth significantly outpaces tier-1 and tier-2 cities.
182	Third, the 25-35 female user segment has an ARPU 1.8x the overall average.
183	
184	Key points: (1) Growth engine shifting from acquisition to retention (2) Lower-tier market opportunity window (3) High-value user persona
185	Duration: 2 minutes
186	```
187	
188	---
189	
190	## Self-check Supplement (Consultant-specific)
191	
192	- [ ] Data matches source data — no fabrication
193	- [ ] Every data page has a source attribution at the bottom
194	- [ ] Page titles are assertion-based, not descriptive
195	- [ ] KPI cards have trend arrows and comparison annotations
196	- [ ] Chart colors are unified, using monochromatic scheme rather than rainbow
197	- [ ] Notes are conclusion-first with conversational data
198

# Executor Consultant — Consulting Style

> Common guidelines: executor-base.md. Technical constraints: shared-standards.md.

---

## Role Definition

A data-driven, consulting-style SVG design executor. Suitable for business analysis reports, market research, operational reviews, strategic recommendations, and other **general consulting** scenarios. Emphasizes structured information presentation and data visualization; clean, clear, and professional style.

---

## Consultant-specific Data Visualization Techniques

### 1. KPI Dashboard Design

KPI cards are the most common element in consulting reports. Standard layout (1280x720):

```
4-card layout: each card 280x180, gap 30
  Card 1: x=45,  y=160
  Card 2: x=355, y=160
  Card 3: x=665, y=160
  Card 4: x=975, y=160
```

**Card internal structure** (top to bottom):

| Area | Content | Font Size | Style |
|------|---------|-----------|-------|
| Icon row | data-icon icon | 32x32 | Theme color |
| Metric name | "Monthly Active Users" | 14px | Gray #64748B |
| Core number | "1.2M" | 36-42px | Bold, dark color |
| Trend annotation | "+12.3% vs last month" | 12px | Green=up / Red=down |

**Trend arrow conventions**:
- Up: `arrow-trend-up` icon + green text
- Down: `arrow-trend-down` icon + red text
- Flat: horizontal line icon + gray text

### 2. Chart Color Conventions

Consulting-style charts use **monochromatic depth gradients** rather than rainbow colors:

```
Primary series:   Theme color 100% opacity
Comparison series: Theme color 60% opacity
Baseline:         #94A3B8 (gray dashed line)
Highlight:        Accent color (only for key data points)
```

### 3. Data Annotation Principles

- **Direct data labels**: Place values at the top of bar charts — no legend needed
- **Annotated trend lines**: Add text notes at key inflection points ("Policy change", "Product launch")
- **Comparison baselines**: Mark industry average / target values with gray dashed lines
- **Consistent units**: Maintain the same numeric units and precision within a chart

### 4. Table Design

Consulting reports frequently use tables for precise data:

| Design Element | Specification |
|----------------|---------------|
| Header | Dark background + white text, font-weight="bold" |
| Zebra striping | Alternate rows with `fill-opacity="0.05"` light background |
| Number alignment | Numbers right-aligned, text left-aligned |
| Highlighted row | Mark key rows with accent color `fill-opacity="0.1"` |
| Borders | Use horizontal lines only to separate rows; avoid full grid lines |

---

## Consulting-specific Layout Patterns

### MECE Decomposition Tree

Main trunk on the left, branches expanding rightward — mutually exclusive, collectively exhaustive:

```
Main metric ──┬── Branch A (45%)
              ├── Branch B (30%)
              ├── Branch C (20%)
              └── Branch D (5%)
```

- Use `<line>` to connect trunk to branches
- Each branch has a `<rect>` container + percentage annotation
- Sum must = 100% (or explicitly label "Other")

### Driver Factor Tree

Top-level metric → decomposed factors → actions. Ideal for performance attribution analysis:

```
Revenue growth 15%
  ├── Average order value +8%  → Premium product line expansion
  ├── Customer count +5%       → New channel acquisition
  └── Repurchase rate +2%      → Loyalty program optimization
```

### Left-chart Right-text (Chart Interpretation)

Core consulting report layout: chart on the left, key insights on the right:

```
Chart area: x=40, y=120, w=700, h=480
Insight area: x=780, y=120, w=460, h=480
  - Core conclusion (bold, 16px)
  - 3-5 bullet points (14px)
  - Data source (12px, gray)
```

---

## Professional Expression Standards

### Page Titles

Consulting-style page titles should be **assertion headlines**, not descriptive titles:

| Type | Descriptive (avoid) | Assertion (recommended) |
|------|---------------------|------------------------|
| Market | "Market Overview" | "Domestic market grows 23% YoY, significantly outpacing global average" |
| Competition | "Competitive Analysis" | "Three major competitors show clear weaknesses in channel coverage" |
| Finance | "Financial Data" | "Gross margin improved for four consecutive quarters, breaking industry ceiling" |

### Data Source Attribution

Every data-containing page must include a source note at the bottom:

```xml
<text x="40" y="700" font-size="10" fill="#94A3B8">
  Source: National Bureau of Statistics 2025 Annual Report; Internal team analysis
</text>
```

### Key Takeaway Box

Consulting-style content pages should include a **Takeaway Box** below the title:

```
Position: x=40, y=80, w=1200, h=50
Background: Light theme color (fill-opacity="0.08")
Text: 14-16px, one-sentence summary of the page's core takeaway
```

---

## Speaker Notes Style

### Narrative Tone

Consultant-style speaker notes use a **conclusion-driven** approach — state the conclusion first, then present supporting evidence. Professional, concise, and persuasive tone.

### Stage Direction Markers

| Marker | Purpose | Example |
|--------|---------|---------|
| `[Pause]` | Silence after key conclusions, let the audience absorb | "This means our market share is being eroded. [Pause]" |
| `[Data]` | Cue to verbalize numbers conversationally | "[Data] 85% → more than eight out of ten customers reported this issue" |
| `[Transition]` | Bridge from previous page, must be at start of each page's text | "[Transition] Based on that analysis, let's look at specific recommendations." |

### Notes Writing Guidelines

- **Conclusion first**: The first sentence of each page's notes is the core takeaway
- **Conversational data**: 30% → "roughly one-third", 85% → "more than eight out of ten", 2.5x → "two and a half times"
- **Evidence follows immediately**: After the conclusion, provide 2-3 supporting data points/facts
- **Professional terminology**: Use terms like "insight", "driver", "key lever" etc.
- **Key points structure**: `Key points: (1) Core conclusion (2) Supporting data (3) Next steps`

### Notes Example

```markdown
# 03_key_findings

[Transition] Based on our market scan, we have distilled three key findings.

First, the primary growth driver is shifting from acquisition to retention.
[Data] New customer acquisition cost rose nearly 40% year-over-year, yet improved repurchase rates contributed over 60% of revenue growth. [Pause]

Second, lower-tier market growth significantly outpaces tier-1 and tier-2 cities.
Third, the 25-35 female user segment has an ARPU 1.8x the overall average.

Key points: (1) Growth engine shifting from acquisition to retention (2) Lower-tier market opportunity window (3) High-value user persona
Duration: 2 minutes
```

---

## Self-check Supplement (Consultant-specific)

- [ ] Data matches source data — no fabrication
- [ ] Every data page has a source attribution at the bottom
- [ ] Page titles are assertion-based, not descriptive
- [ ] KPI cards have trend arrows and comparison annotations
- [ ] Chart colors are unified, using monochromatic scheme rather than rainbow
- [ ] Notes are conclusion-first with conversational data

Consultant-style speaker notes use a **conclusion-driven** approach — state the conclusion first, then present supporting evidence. Professional, concise, and persuasive tone.

### Stage Direction Markers

| Marker | Purpose | Example |
|--------|---------|---------|
| `[Pause]` | Silence after key conclusions, let the audience absorb | "This means our market share is being eroded. [Pause]" |
| `[Data]` | Cue to verbalize numbers conversationally | "[Data] 85% → more than eight out of ten customers reported this issue" |
| `[Transition]` | Bridge from previous page, must be at start of each page's text | "[Transition] Based on that analysis, let's look at specific recommendations." |

### Notes Writing Guidelines

- **Conclusion first**: The first sentence of each page's notes is the core takeaway
- **Conversational data**: 30% → "roughly one-third", 85% → "more than eight out of ten", 2.5x → "two and a half times"
- **Evidence follows immediately**: After the conclusion, provide 2-3 supporting data points/facts
- **Professional terminology**: Use terms like "insight", "driver", "key lever" etc.
- **Key points structure**: `Key points: (1) Core conclusion (2) Supporting data (3) Next steps`

### Notes Example

```markdown
# 03_key_findings

[Transition] Based on our market scan, we have distilled three key findings.

First, the primary growth driver is shifting from acquisition to retention.
[Data] New customer acquisition cost rose nearly 40% year-over-year, yet improved repurchase rates contributed over 60% of revenue growth. [Pause]

Second, lower-tier market growth significantly outpaces tier-1 and tier-2 cities.
Third, the 25-35 female user segment has an ARPU 1.8x the overall average.

Key points: (1) Growth engine shifting from acquisition to retention (2) Lower-tier market opportunity window (3) High-value user persona
Duration: 2 minutes
```

---

## Self-check Supplement (Consultant-specific)

- [ ] Data matches source data — no fabrication
- [ ] Every data page has a source attribution at the bottom
- [ ] Page titles are assertion-based, not descriptive
- [ ] KPI cards have trend arrows and comparison annotations
- [ ] Chart colors are unified, using monochromatic scheme rather than rainbow
- [ ] Notes are conclusion-first with conversational data

42

44

48	Baseline:         #94A3B8 (gray dashed line)
49	Highlight:        Accent color (only for key data points)
50	```

53

2	
3	> Style-specific content is in the corresponding `executor-{style}.md`. Technical constraints are in shared-standards.md.
4	
5	---
6	
7	## 1. Template Adherence Rules
8	
9	If template files exist in the project's `templates/` directory, the template structure must be followed:
10	
11	| Page Type | Corresponding Template | Adherence Rules |
12	|-----------|----------------------|-----------------|
13	| Cover | `01_cover.svg` | Inherit background, decorative elements, layout structure; replace placeholder content |
14	| Chapter | `02_chapter.svg` | Inherit numbering style, title position, decorative elements |
15	| Content | `03_content.svg` | Inherit header/footer styles; **content area may be freely laid out** |
16	| Ending | `04_ending.svg` | Inherit background, thank-you message position, contact info layout |
17	| TOC | `02_toc.svg` | **Optional**: Inherit TOC title, list styles |
18	
19	### Page-Template Mapping Declaration (Required Output)
20	
21	Before generating each page, you must explicitly output which template (or "free design") is used:
22	
23	```
24	📝 **Template mapping**: `templates/01_cover.svg` (or "None (free design)")
25	🎯 **Adherence rules / layout strategy**: [specific description]
26	```
27	
28	- **Content pages**: Templates only define header and footer; the content area is freely laid out by the Executor
29	- **No template**: Generate entirely per the Design Specification & Content Outline
30	
31	---
32	
33	## 2. Design Parameter Confirmation (Mandatory Step)
34	
35	> Before generating the first SVG page, you **must review the key design parameters from the Design Specification & Content Outline** to ensure all subsequent generation strictly follows the spec.
36	
37	Must output confirmation including: canvas dimensions, body font size, color scheme (primary/secondary/accent HEX values), font plan.
38	
39	**Why is this step mandatory?** Prevents the "spec says one thing, execution does another" disconnect.
40	
41	---
42	
43	## 3. Execution Guidelines
44	
45	- **Proximity principle**: Place related elements close together to form visual groups; increase spacing between unrelated groups to reinforce logical structure
46	- **Absolute spec adherence**: Strictly follow the color, layout, canvas format, and typography parameters in the spec
47	- **Follow template structure**: If templates exist, inherit the template's visual framework
48	- **Phased batch generation** (recommended):
49	  1. **Visual Construction Phase**: Generate all SVG pages continuously, ensuring high consistency in design style and layout coordinates (Visual Consistency)
50	  2. **Logic Construction Phase**: After all SVGs are finalized, batch-generate speaker notes to ensure narrative coherence (Narrative Continuity)
51	- **Technical specifications**: See [shared-standards.md](shared-standards.md) for SVG technical constraints and PPT compatibility rules
52	
53	### SVG File Naming Convention
54	
55	File naming format: `<number>_<page_name>.svg`
56	
57	- **Chinese content** → Chinese naming: `01_封面.svg`, `02_目录.svg`, `03_核心优势.svg`
58	- **English content** → English naming: `01_cover.svg`, `02_agenda.svg`, `03_key_benefits.svg`
59	- **Number rules**: Two-digit numbers, starting from 01
60	- **Page name**: Concise and descriptive, matching the page title in the Design Specification & Content Outline
61	
62	---
63	
64	## 4. Icon Usage
65	
66	Four approaches: **A: Emoji** (`<text>🚀</text>`) | **B: AI-generated** (SVG basic shapes) | **C: Built-in library** (`templates/icons/` 640+ icons, recommended) | **D: Custom** (user-specified)
67	
68	**Built-in icons — Placeholder method (recommended)**:
69	
70	```xml
71	<use data-icon="chart-bar" x="100" y="200" width="48" height="48" fill="#005587"/>
72	```
73	
74	> No need to manually run `embed_icons.py`; `finalize_svg.py` post-processing tool will auto-embed icons.
75	
76	**Common icons**: `chart-bar` `arrow-trend-up` `users` `cog` `circle-checkmark` `target` `clock` `file` `dollar` `lightbulb`
77	
78	> ⚠️ **Icon validation rule**: If the Design Specification includes an icon inventory list, Executor may **only** use icons from that approved list. Using icon names not in the index is FORBIDDEN — verify against `templates/icons/icons_index.json` if uncertain.
79	
80	Full index: `templates/icons/README.md`
81	
82	---
83	
84	## 5. Chart Reference
85	
86	When the Design Spec includes a **VII. Chart Reference List**, read the referenced SVG templates from `templates/charts/` to understand common chart patterns.
87	
88	**Adaptation rules**:
89	- **Must preserve**: Chart type (bar/line/pie etc.) as specified in the Design Spec
90	- **Must adapt**: Data values, labels, colors (match the project's color scheme), and dimensions to fit the page layout
91	- **May adjust**: Axis ranges, grid lines, legend position, spacing — as long as the chart remains accurate and readable
92	- **Must NOT**: Change chart type without Design Spec justification, or remove data points specified in the outline
93	
94	> Chart templates: `templates/charts/` (33 types). Index: `templates/charts/charts_index.json`
95	
96	---
97	
98	## 6. Image Handling
99	
100	Handle images based on their status in the Design Specification's "Image Resource List":
101	
102	| Status | Source | Handling |
103	|--------|--------|----------|
104	| **Existing** | User-provided | Reference images directly from `../images/` directory |
105	| **AI-generated** | Generated by Image_Generator | Images already in `../images/`, reference directly |
106	| **Placeholder** | Not yet prepared | Use dashed border placeholder |
107	
108	**Reference**: `<image href="../images/xxx.png" ... preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"/>`
109	
110	**Placeholder**: Dashed border `<rect stroke-dasharray="8,4" .../>` + description text
111	
112	---
113	
114	## 7. Font Usage
115	
116	Apply corresponding fonts for different text roles based on the font plan in the Design Specification & Content Outline:
117	
118	| Role | Chinese Recommended | English Recommended |
119	|------|--------------------|--------------------|
120	| Title font | Microsoft YaHei / KaiTi / SimHei | Arial / Georgia |
121	| Body font | Microsoft YaHei / SimSun | Calibri / Times |
122	| Emphasis font | SimHei | Arial Black / Consolas |
123	| Annotation font | Microsoft YaHei / SimSun | Arial / Times |
124	
125	---
126	
127	## 8. Speaker Notes Generation Framework
128	
129	### Task 1. Generate Complete Speaker Notes Document
130	
131	After **all SVG pages are generated and finalized**, enter the "Logic Construction Phase" and generate the complete speaker notes document in `notes/total.md`.
132	
133	**Why not generate page-by-page?** Batch-writing notes allows planning transitions like a script, ensuring coherent presentation logic.
134	
135	**Format**: Each page starts with `# <number>_<page_title>`, separated by `---` between pages. Each page includes: script text (2-5 sentences), `Key points: ① ② ③`, `Duration: X minutes`. Except for the first page, each page's text starts with a `[Transition]` phrase.
136	
137	**Basic stage direction markers** (common to all styles):
138	
139	| Marker | Purpose |
140	|--------|---------|
141	| `[Pause]` | Whitespace after key content, letting the audience absorb |
142	| `[Transition]` | Standalone paragraph at the start of each page's text, bridging from the previous page |
143	
144	> Each style may extend with additional markers (`[Interactive]`/`[Data]`/`[Scan Room]`/`[Benchmark]` etc.), see `executor-{style}.md`.
145	
146	**Requirements**:
147	
148	- Notes should be conversational and flow naturally
149	- Highlight each page's core information and presentation key points
150	- Users can manually edit and override in the `notes/` directory
151	
152	### Task 2. Split Into Per-Page Note Files
153	
154	Automatically split `notes/total.md` into individual speaker note files in the `notes/` directory.
155	
156	**File naming convention**:
157	
158	- **Recommended**: Match SVG names (e.g., `01_cover.svg` → `notes/01_cover.md`)
159	- **Compatible**: Also supports `slide01.md` format (backward compatibility)
160	
161	---
162	
163	## 9. Next Steps After Completion
164	
165	> **Auto-continuation**: After Visual Construction Phase (all SVG pages) and Logic Construction Phase (all notes) are complete, the Executor proceeds directly to the post-processing pipeline.
166	
167	**Post-processing & Export** (see [shared-standards.md](shared-standards.md)):

172	
173	# 2. SVG post-processing (auto-embed icons, images, etc.)
174	python3 scripts/finalize_svg.py <project_path>
175	
176	# 3. Export PPTX
177	python3 scripts/svg_to_pptx.py <project_path> -s final
178	# Default: generates native shapes (.pptx) + SVG reference (_svg.pptx)
179	```
180

# Executor Common Guidelines

> Style-specific content is in the corresponding `executor-{style}.md`. Technical constraints are in shared-standards.md.

---

## 1. Template Adherence Rules

If template files exist in the project's `templates/` directory, the template structure must be followed:

| Page Type | Corresponding Template | Adherence Rules |
|-----------|----------------------|-----------------|
| Cover | `01_cover.svg` | Inherit background, decorative elements, layout structure; replace placeholder content |
| Chapter | `02_chapter.svg` | Inherit numbering style, title position, decorative elements |
| Content | `03_content.svg` | Inherit header/footer styles; **content area may be freely laid out** |
| Ending | `04_ending.svg` | Inherit background, thank-you message position, contact info layout |
| TOC | `02_toc.svg` | **Optional**: Inherit TOC title, list styles |

### Page-Template Mapping Declaration (Required Output)

Before generating each page, you must explicitly output which template (or "free design") is used:

```
📝 **Template mapping**: `templates/01_cover.svg` (or "None (free design)")
🎯 **Adherence rules / layout strategy**: [specific description]
```

- **Content pages**: Templates only define header and footer; the content area is freely laid out by the Executor
- **No template**: Generate entirely per the Design Specification & Content Outline

---

## 2. Design Parameter Confirmation (Mandatory Step)

> Before generating the first SVG page, you **must review the key design parameters from the Design Specification & Content Outline** to ensure all subsequent generation strictly follows the spec.

Must output confirmation including: canvas dimensions, body font size, color scheme (primary/secondary/accent HEX values), font plan.

**Why is this step mandatory?** Prevents the "spec says one thing, execution does another" disconnect.

---

## 3. Execution Guidelines

- **Proximity principle**: Place related elements close together to form visual groups; increase spacing between unrelated groups to reinforce logical structure
- **Absolute spec adherence**: Strictly follow the color, layout, canvas format, and typography parameters in the spec
- **Follow template structure**: If templates exist, inherit the template's visual framework
- **Phased batch generation** (recommended):
  1. **Visual Construction Phase**: Generate all SVG pages continuously, ensuring high consistency in design style and layout coordinates (Visual Consistency)
  2. **Logic Construction Phase**: After all SVGs are finalized, batch-generate speaker notes to ensure narrative coherence (Narrative Continuity)
- **Technical specifications**: See [shared-standards.md](shared-standards.md) for SVG technical constraints and PPT compatibility rules

### SVG File Naming Convention

File naming format: `<number>_<page_name>.svg`

- **Chinese content** → Chinese naming: `01_封面.svg`, `02_目录.svg`, `03_核心优势.svg`
- **English content** → English naming: `01_cover.svg`, `02_agenda.svg`, `03_key_benefits.svg`
- **Number rules**: Two-digit numbers, starting from 01
- **Page name**: Concise and descriptive, matching the page title in the Design Specification & Content Outline

---

## 4. Icon Usage

Four approaches: **A: Emoji** (`<text>🚀</text>`) | **B: AI-generated** (SVG basic shapes) | **C: Built-in library** (`templates/icons/` 640+ icons, recommended) | **D: Custom** (user-specified)

**Built-in icons — Placeholder method (recommended)**:

```xml
<use data-icon="chart-bar" x="100" y="200" width="48" height="48" fill="#005587"/>
```

> No need to manually run `embed_icons.py`; `finalize_svg.py` post-processing tool will auto-embed icons.

**Common icons**: `chart-bar` `arrow-trend-up` `users` `cog` `circle-checkmark` `target` `clock` `file` `dollar` `lightbulb`

> ⚠️ **Icon validation rule**: If the Design Specification includes an icon inventory list, Executor may **only** use icons from that approved list. Using icon names not in the index is FORBIDDEN — verify against `templates/icons/icons_index.json` if uncertain.

Full index: `templates/icons/README.md`

---

## 5. Chart Reference

When the Design Spec includes a **VII. Chart Reference List**, read the referenced SVG templates from `templates/charts/` to understand common chart patterns.

**Adaptation rules**:
- **Must preserve**: Chart type (bar/line/pie etc.) as specified in the Design Spec
- **Must adapt**: Data values, labels, colors (match the project's color scheme), and dimensions to fit the page layout
- **May adjust**: Axis ranges, grid lines, legend position, spacing — as long as the chart remains accurate and readable
- **Must NOT**: Change chart type without Design Spec justification, or remove data points specified in the outline

> Chart templates: `templates/charts/` (33 types). Index: `templates/charts/charts_index.json`

---

## 6. Image Handling

Handle images based on their status in the Design Specification's "Image Resource List":

| Status | Source | Handling |
|--------|--------|----------|
| **Existing** | User-provided | Reference images directly from `../images/` directory |
| **AI-generated** | Generated by Image_Generator | Images already in `../images/`, reference directly |
| **Placeholder** | Not yet prepared | Use dashed border placeholder |

**Reference**: `<image href="../images/xxx.png" ... preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"/>`

**Placeholder**: Dashed border `<rect stroke-dasharray="8,4" .../>` + description text

---

## 7. Font Usage

Apply corresponding fonts for different text roles based on the font plan in the Design Specification & Content Outline:

| Role | Chinese Recommended | English Recommended |
|------|--------------------|--------------------|
| Title font | Microsoft YaHei / KaiTi / SimHei | Arial / Georgia |
| Body font | Microsoft YaHei / SimSun | Calibri / Times |
| Emphasis font | SimHei | Arial Black / Consolas |
| Annotation font | Microsoft YaHei / SimSun | Arial / Times |

---

## 8. Speaker Notes Generation Framework

### Task 1. Generate Complete Speaker Notes Document

After **all SVG pages are generated and finalized**, enter the "Logic Construction Phase" and generate the complete speaker notes document in `notes/total.md`.

**Why not generate page-by-page?** Batch-writing notes allows planning transitions like a script, ensuring coherent presentation logic.

**Format**: Each page starts with `# <number>_<page_title>`, separated by `---` between pages. Each page includes: script text (2-5 sentences), `Key points: ① ② ③`, `Duration: X minutes`. Except for the first page, each page's text starts with a `[Transition]` phrase.

**Basic stage direction markers** (common to all styles):

| Marker | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `[Pause]` | Whitespace after key content, letting the audience absorb |
| `[Transition]` | Standalone paragraph at the start of each page's text, bridging from the previous page |

> Each style may extend with additional markers (`[Interactive]`/`[Data]`/`[Scan Room]`/`[Benchmark]` etc.), see `executor-{style}.md`.

**Requirements**:

- Notes should be conversational and flow naturally
- Highlight each page's core information and presentation key points
- Users can manually edit and override in the `notes/` directory

### Task 2. Split Into Per-Page Note Files

Automatically split `notes/total.md` into individual speaker note files in the `notes/` directory.

**File naming convention**:

- **Recommended**: Match SVG names (e.g., `01_cover.svg` → `notes/01_cover.md`)
- **Compatible**: Also supports `slide01.md` format (backward compatibility)

---

## 9. Next Steps After Completion

> **Auto-continuation**: After Visual Construction Phase (all SVG pages) and Logic Construction Phase (all notes) are complete, the Executor proceeds directly to the post-processing pipeline.

**Post-processing & Export** (see [shared-standards.md](shared-standards.md)):

```bash
# 1. Split speaker notes
python3 scripts/total_md_split.py <project_path>

# 2. SVG post-processing (auto-embed icons, images, etc.)
python3 scripts/finalize_svg.py <project_path>

# 3. Export PPTX
python3 scripts/svg_to_pptx.py <project_path> -s final
# Default: generates native shapes (.pptx) + SVG reference (_svg.pptx)
```

43	## 3. Execution Guidelines
44	
45	- **Proximity principle**: Place related elements close together to form visual groups; increase spacing between unrelated groups to reinforce logical structure
46	- **Absolute spec adherence**: Strictly follow the color, layout, canvas format, and typography parameters in the spec
47	- **Follow template structure**: If templates exist, inherit the template's visual framework
48	- **Phased batch generation** (recommended):

51	- **Technical specifications**: See [shared-standards.md](shared-standards.md) for SVG technical constraints and PPT compatibility rules

54	
55	File naming format: `<number>_<page_name>.svg`
56	
57	- **Chinese content** → Chinese naming: `01_封面.svg`, `02_目录.svg`, `03_核心优势.svg`
58	- **English content** → English naming: `01_cover.svg`, `02_agenda.svg`, `03_key_benefits.svg`

130	
131	After **all SVG pages are generated and finalized**, enter the "Logic Construction Phase" and generate the complete speaker notes document in `notes/total.md`.
132	
133	**Why not generate page-by-page?** Batch-writing notes allows planning transitions like a script, ensuring coherent presentation logic.
134	
135	**Format**: Each page starts with `# <number>_<page_title>`, separated by `---` between pages. Each page includes: script text (2-5 sentences), `Key points: ① ② ③`, `Duration: X minutes`. Except for the first page, each page's text starts with a `[Transition]` phrase.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
    <!-- 模板: 内容页 - Anthropic 风格 -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 卡片渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="cardGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FFFFFF"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#F8FAFC"/>
        </linearGradient>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 白色背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- 顶部橙色装饰条 -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="6" fill="#D97757"/>
    
    <!-- 页面标签 -->
    <text x="60" y="55" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#D97757" letter-spacing="2">
        {{PAGE_LABEL}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 页面标题（核心观点） -->
    <text x="60" y="100" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">
        {{PAGE_TITLE}}
    </text>
    <text x="60" y="135" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">
        {{PAGE_TITLE_LINE2}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 三列卡片布局 -->
    <!-- 卡片1 - 绿色（推荐/成功） -->
    <g>
        <rect x="60" y="180" width="360" height="420" fill="url(#cardGradient)" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="1" rx="12"/>
        <rect x="60" y="180" width="360" height="6" fill="#10B981" rx="3"/>
        
        <!-- 图标背景 -->
        <circle cx="130" cy="250" r="35" fill="#10B981" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
        <!-- 图标占位 -->
        <text x="130" y="258" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#10B981">💡</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片标题 -->
        <text x="90" y="320" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_1_TITLE}}</text>
        <text x="90" y="348" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_1_SUBTITLE}}</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片内容 -->
        <text x="90" y="400" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_1_LINE1}}</text>
        <text x="90" y="428" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_1_LINE2}}</text>
        <text x="90" y="470" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_1_NOTE1}}</text>
        <text x="90" y="494" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_1_NOTE2}}</text>
        
        <!-- 标签 -->
        <rect x="90" y="545" width="80" height="28" fill="#10B981" fill-opacity="0.1" rx="14"/>
        <text x="130" y="564" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#10B981">{{CARD_1_TAG}}</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 卡片2 - 蓝色（流程/架构） -->
    <g>
        <rect x="460" y="180" width="360" height="420" fill="url(#cardGradient)" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="1" rx="12"/>
        <rect x="460" y="180" width="360" height="6" fill="#4A90D9" rx="3"/>
        
        <!-- 图标背景 -->
        <circle cx="530" cy="250" r="35" fill="#4A90D9" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
        <!-- 图标占位 -->
        <text x="530" y="258" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#4A90D9">⚡</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片标题 -->
        <text x="490" y="320" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_2_TITLE}}</text>
        <text x="490" y="348" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_2_SUBTITLE}}</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片内容 -->
        <text x="490" y="400" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_2_LINE1}}</text>
        <text x="490" y="428" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_2_LINE2}}</text>
        <text x="490" y="470" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_2_NOTE1}}</text>
        <text x="490" y="494" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_2_NOTE2}}</text>
        
        <!-- 标签 -->
        <rect x="490" y="545" width="80" height="28" fill="#4A90D9" fill-opacity="0.1" rx="14"/>
        <text x="530" y="564" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#4A90D9">{{CARD_2_TAG}}</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 卡片3 - 橙色（关键洞察） -->
    <g>
        <rect x="860" y="180" width="360" height="420" fill="url(#cardGradient)" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="1" rx="12"/>
        <rect x="860" y="180" width="360" height="6" fill="#D97757" rx="3"/>
        
        <!-- 图标背景 -->
        <circle cx="930" cy="250" r="35" fill="#D97757" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
        <!-- 图标占位 -->
        <text x="930" y="258" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#D97757">⚙️</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片标题 -->
        <text x="890" y="320" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_3_TITLE}}</text>
        <text x="890" y="348" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_3_SUBTITLE}}</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片内容 -->
        <text x="890" y="400" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_3_LINE1}}</text>
        <text x="890" y="428" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_3_LINE2}}</text>
        <text x="890" y="470" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_3_NOTE1}}</text>
        <text x="890" y="494" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_3_NOTE2}}</text>
        
        <!-- 标签 -->
        <rect x="890" y="545" width="80" height="28" fill="#D97757" fill-opacity="0.1" rx="14"/>
        <text x="930" y="564" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#D97757">{{CARD_3_TAG}}</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 页码 -->
    <text x="640" y="680" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#64748B" text-anchor="middle">
        {{PAGE_NUM}} / {{TOTAL_PAGES}}
    </text>

</svg>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
    <!-- 模板: 结束页 - Anthropic 风格 -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 背景渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="bgGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#1A1A2E"/>
            <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#16213E"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#0F0F1A"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 橙色渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="accentGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#D97757"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#E8956F"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 光晕效果 -->
        <radialGradient id="glowOrange" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#D97757;stop-opacity:0.2"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#D97757;stop-opacity:0"/>
        </radialGradient>
        <radialGradient id="glowBlue" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4A90D9;stop-opacity:0.15"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#4A90D9;stop-opacity:0"/>
        </radialGradient>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 渐变背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#bgGradient)"/>
    
    <!-- 网格装饰线 -->
    <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.02" stroke-width="1">
        <line x1="0" y1="180" x2="1280" y2="180"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="360" x2="1280" y2="360"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="540" x2="1280" y2="540"/>
        <line x1="320" y1="0" x2="320" y2="720"/>
        <line x1="640" y1="0" x2="640" y2="720"/>
        <line x1="960" y1="0" x2="960" y2="720"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 光晕效果 -->
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="200" rx="250" ry="180" fill="url(#glowBlue)"/>
    <ellipse cx="980" cy="500" rx="280" ry="200" fill="url(#glowOrange)"/>
    
    <!-- 神经网络连接装饰 -->
    <g stroke="#4A90D9" stroke-opacity="0.3" stroke-width="1" fill="none">
        <path d="M150,150 Q250,100 350,180"/>
        <path d="M350,180 Q420,250 380,320"/>
        <path d="M950,400 Q1050,350 1100,420"/>
        <path d="M1100,420 Q1150,500 1080,550"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 节点装饰 -->
    <g fill="#4A90D9" fill-opacity="0.5">
        <circle cx="150" cy="150" r="5"/>
        <circle cx="350" cy="180" r="7"/>
        <circle cx="380" cy="320" r="4"/>
    </g>
    <g fill="#D97757" fill-opacity="0.6">
        <circle cx="950" cy="400" r="6"/>
        <circle cx="1100" cy="420" r="8"/>
        <circle cx="1080" cy="550" r="5"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 感谢语标签 -->
    <text x="640" y="240" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#D97757" letter-spacing="3">
        THANK YOU
    </text>
    
    <!-- 主感谢语 -->
    <text x="640" y="310" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="52" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">
        {{THANK_YOU}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 装饰分隔线 -->
    <rect x="540" y="350" width="200" height="3" fill="url(#accentGradient)" rx="1.5"/>
    
    <!-- 副标语 -->
    <text x="640" y="410" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7">
        {{TAGLINE}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 联系信息卡片 -->
    <rect x="440" y="460" width="400" height="120" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.05" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.1" stroke-width="1" rx="12"/>
    
    <text x="640" y="505" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">
        {{CONTACT_NAME}}
    </text>
    <text x="640" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7">
        {{CONTACT_EMAIL}}
    </text>
    <text x="640" y="560" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.6">
        {{CONTACT_URL}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 底部分隔线 -->
    <rect x="60" y="640" width="1160" height="1" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
    
    <!-- 底部信息 -->
    <text x="60" y="680" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#64748B">
        {{DATE}}
    </text>
    <text x="1220" y="680" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#64748B">
        {{COPYRIGHT}}
    </text>

</svg>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
    <!-- 模板: 封面页 - Anthropic 风格 -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 背景渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="bgGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#1A1A2E"/>
            <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#16213E"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#0F0F1A"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 橙色渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="accentGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#D97757"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#E8956F"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 光晕效果 -->
        <radialGradient id="glowOrange" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#D97757;stop-opacity:0.3"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#D97757;stop-opacity:0"/>
        </radialGradient>
        <radialGradient id="glowBlue" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4A90D9;stop-opacity:0.2"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#4A90D9;stop-opacity:0"/>
        </radialGradient>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 渐变背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#bgGradient)"/>
    
    <!-- 网格装饰线 -->
    <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.03" stroke-width="1">
        <line x1="0" y1="180" x2="1280" y2="180"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="360" x2="1280" y2="360"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="540" x2="1280" y2="540"/>
        <line x1="320" y1="0" x2="320" y2="720"/>
        <line x1="640" y1="0" x2="640" y2="720"/>
        <line x1="960" y1="0" x2="960" y2="720"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 光晕效果 -->
    <ellipse cx="1100" cy="150" rx="300" ry="200" fill="url(#glowOrange)"/>
    <ellipse cx="200" cy="550" rx="250" ry="180" fill="url(#glowBlue)"/>
    
    <!-- 神经网络连接线 -->
    <g stroke="#4A90D9" stroke-opacity="0.4" stroke-width="1" fill="none">
        <path d="M100,200 Q250,150 350,220"/>
        <path d="M350,220 Q450,280 500,200"/>
        <path d="M900,480 Q1000,420 1100,480"/>
        <path d="M1100,480 Q1150,550 1200,500"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 蓝色节点 -->
    <g fill="#4A90D9" fill-opacity="0.6">
        <circle cx="100" cy="200" r="4"/>
        <circle cx="350" cy="220" r="6"/>
        <circle cx="500" cy="200" r="4"/>
        <circle cx="900" cy="480" r="5"/>
        <circle cx="1100" cy="480" r="7"/>
        <circle cx="1200" cy="500" r="4"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 橙色节点 -->
    <g fill="#D97757" fill-opacity="0.7">
        <circle cx="1050" cy="180" r="8"/>
        <circle cx="1150" cy="120" r="5"/>
        <circle cx="180" cy="520" r="6"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 左上角装饰短线 -->
    <rect x="60" y="60" width="80" height="4" fill="url(#accentGradient)" rx="2"/>
    
    <!-- 品牌标识 -->
    <text x="60" y="100" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#D97757" letter-spacing="2">
        {{BRAND_LABEL}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 主标题 -->
    <text x="640" y="300" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="56" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">
        {{TITLE}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 副标题 -->
    <text x="640" y="365" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.85" text-anchor="middle">
        {{SUBTITLE}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 装饰分隔线 -->
    <rect x="540" y="400" width="200" height="3" fill="url(#accentGradient)" rx="1.5"/>
    
    <!-- 引用语 -->
    <text x="640" y="465" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7" text-anchor="middle">
        "{{TAGLINE}}"
    </text>
    
    <!-- 底部信息 -->
    <rect x="60" y="650" width="1160" height="1" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
    <text x="60" y="680" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#64748B">
        {{DATE}}
    </text>
    <text x="1220" y="680" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#64748B">
        {{SOURCE}}
    </text>

</svg>
